decisions.reason: The cleaning soap is a low-cost addition to the established floor-care range, and two years after launch any weak demand can still be put down to a ramp-up phase, so management stays with it.
The multi-model maintenance oil line is a visible investment that underpins the firm's announced surface-treatment and maintenance offer, which argues for persisting with it.
The care line for oiled floors is tied directly to the firm's oiled-floor business and carries sunk costs across several models, so dropping it would undercut earlier commitments.

Dropping the moisture-protection underlay already showed a willingness to prune accessories, but the high-density underlay now carries the underlay offer, so management keeps it to keep the accessory portfolio complete.
The oak parquet line is at the core of the firm's production investment and brand, which makes a withdrawal highly unlikely.
